notes.title: Update Patch Notes - May 28, 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35021308/da7d95dfe53b0cfe89d6190caa2ab05d40d8132e.png[/img]
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: Crash-Kill bonus[/b]
(+ bonus score for killing people with crashed ufo)

[b]Added: Selectable Cities[/b]
(New York, Moscow, Tokyo)

[b]Added: New Achievements[/b]
Cliffhanger - (Throw down 100 Climbers)
Bomberman - (Blow up 100 Bombermans)

Enjoy the game! :)
